title: Avatar
description: Image or initials in circle and square shapes, with tones drawn from the grey ramp and a stacked group

props.name: name
props.description: Avatar: accessible image name and source for fallback initials.

props.name: src
props.description: Avatar: image URL. A failed image falls back to the supplied fallback or initials.

props.name: fallback
props.description: Avatar: custom fallback content; otherwise uses initials from the first two name words.

props.name: size
props.description: Avatar: size treatment; defaults to md.

props.name: shape
props.description: Avatar: outline geometry; defaults to circle.

props.name: tone
props.description: Avatar: neutral language tone; defaults to 1.

props.name: variant
props.description: Avatar: fill or count treatment; defaults to filled. AvatarGroup accepts native div props.
